gloss: to be silly; to slip up; to be vacant-witted

definitions.gloss: to be silly; to look foolish; to slip up in an absent-minded way
definitions.explanation: Describes acting in a way that misses the point or looks dopey. Most often used in the past form {間抜|まぬ}けた as a noun modifier ({間抜|まぬ}けた{顔|かお} 'a vacant face').

examples.japanese: ⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧た⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has a vacant look on his face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二本|にほん}⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きて、⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧た⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気付|きづ}いた→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: I came home with two umbrellas and realized how absent-minded I'd been.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧た⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Forgetting the materials for an important meeting — even I think that was pretty dim of me.

notes:
Compound of {間|ま} (timing; sense; the proper interval) + ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (to slip out, be missing). Literally 'one's sense slips out' — i.e. the timing or judgement is off.

USAGE:
- The past attributive form ⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧た is the most common shape: ⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧た⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (silly face), ⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧た⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (silly story), ⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧た⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧ (dumb mistake).
- The noun form ⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧ ('a fool, dimwit') is also widely used.
- Tone is light teasing rather than harsh insult.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧: stupid; foolish — stronger and more offensive
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}けている→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧: to be absent-minded — focuses on chronic spaciness rather than a single slip
- ドジ: clumsy; bumbling — emphasizes physical mishap rather than the vacant look

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {間抜|まぬ}けていませんでした
